test: a whole local profile restores stable histories, draft branches and playable media into a fresh profile without renewing Tutor consent

content: Fresh isolated browser profiles. Original repository learning, writing and media fixtures; real export/preview/restore UI. The quota-error state is deliberately induced, not a provider outage or production incident.
limitations: Local portable backup is not hosted account persistence, cloud backup or automatic two-device synchronization.
WebKit iPhone 13 emulation is not physical iPhone Safari or standalone PWA verification.
Captures do not prove full accessibility, screen reader/zoom/contrast/performance compliance or final owner visual approval.
No live AI, dictionary, speech, hosted Auth or external upload is used by these capture journeys.
